title: BSL Flow benchmark task
description: Format for bench/tasks/<id>/task.yaml, per docs/plans/2026-09-26-remediation-plan.md section Ф6.1.

id.description: Task identifier; matches the bench/tasks/<id> directory name.

fixture.description: Either a local fixture directory (path, relative to the repo root) or a public repo pinned at a commit.

request.description: Relative path (from the task directory) to the original-task.md prompt shown to the agent.

expected_scope.description: Glob patterns (relative to the fixture root) the changed files are expected to stay within.

acceptance.description: Hidden checks run against the agent's working tree after the run; never shown to the agent.

ambiguous.description: True when the task is deliberately underspecified; the correct agent behaviour is to ask a clarifying question or report BLOCKED instead of guessing.

requires_runtime.description: True when the check needs a live 1C runtime (e.g. YAxUnit). Such checks are declared but skipped offline; the runner counts them under skipped_runtime.

tests.description: kind: yaxunit. Glob(s) of YAxUnit test files to run against the fixture.

value.description: kind: bslls_new_errors_max. Maximum allowed count of NEW bslls diagnostics with severity Error.

path.description: kind: file_contains / file_absent. Path (relative to the fixture root) of the file to inspect.

pattern.description: kind: file_contains / file_absent. Regex tested against the file content (file_contains) or its non-existence/absence-of-match (file_absent).

command.description: kind: command. Shell command run from the fixture root; exit code 0 is PASS.
